<entry id="S01210">
<head-word>קִישּׁוּט</head-word>
<head-word>קִשּׁ'</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (קָשַׁט) 
<italic>dress, toilet, ornament.</italic></definition>
<notes>
<italic>—</italic>
<plural-form>Pl. קִישּׁוּטִים, קִישּׁוּטִין, קִשּׁ'</plural-form>. Lam. R. to II, 13 (play on אעידך, ib.; cmp. עֲדִי II) כמה ק' קשטתי אתכם with how many ornaments did I adorn you!; Pesik. Naḥ., p. 124
<sup>b</sup>. Keth. 71
<sup>b</sup> נהנית מריח קִשּׁוּטֶיהָ וכ' is benefited by the perfume of her toilet for thirty days (can be thirty days without perfumery). Ib. (in Chald. diction) דתלנהו לקשוטיה וכ' (read: דתלתנהו) when she attached her vow of abstinence from perfuming herself to marital intercourse &c.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01212">
<head-word>קִישּׁוּי</head-word>
<head-word>קִשּׁ'</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (קָשָׁה) 
<italic>protracted travailing, laws of cleanness concerning discharges during protracted travailing</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Nidd. IV, 5 (36
<sup>b</sup>) כמה הוא קִשּׁוּיָהּ (Bab. ed. היא קִישּׁ') how long may her travailing last (in order to apply to her the laws concerning &c.)?; Yeb. 83
<sup>a</sup>; Y. ib. IV, 6
<sup>a</sup>; Y. Nidd. I, 49
<sup>b</sup> top קִישּׁוּיָיהּ; ib. אין ק' יותר וכ' the laws apply only during two weeks. Bab. ib. 66
<sup>a</sup> אין ק' לנפלים the law of 
<italic>ḳishshuy</italic> does not apply to cases of abortion; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01213">
<head-word>קִישּׁוּיָא</head-word>

<senses>

<notes>—

<entry id="S01214">
<head-word>קִישּׁוּר</head-word>
<head-word>קִשּׁ'</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (קָשַׁר) 
<italic>binding, contraction</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 16
<sup>b</sup> בשעת ק' עבים when the clouds were gathering, opp. פיזור. Ib. XV, 1 כשם שהוא חייב על קִישּׁוּרָן וכ' as well as he is guilty (of violating the Sabbath laws), when he ties them (the knots) &c., opp. התיר. Y. ib. IV, 7
<sup>a</sup> top; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. קִישּׁוּרִים, קִשּׁ'</plural-form> (b. h. קִשֻּׁרִים) 
<italic>beads, decorations</italic>. Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXII, end ככלה בקִשּׁוּרֶיהָ like a bride in her attire; Yalk. Gen. 114. Sabb. 66
<sup>b</sup> (expl. קשרים, Mish. VI, 9), קִשּׁוּרֵי פואה (Ms. M. קישור פיאה), v. פּוּאָה; Y. ib. VI, 8
<sup>c</sup> בקושרי פיאה (corr. acc.); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<plural-form>Pl. קִישּׁוּרֵי</plural-form>. Bab. ib. 66

<italic>stilts</italic>, tied to the legs; v. אָנְקִטְמִין.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01226">
<head-word>קִיתוֹן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (κώθων, confounded with κύαθος) 
<italic>ladle</italic> for drawing wine out of the mixing bowl into the cup; also for washing hands.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Bets. II, 9; Tosef. Sabb. XVI (XVII), 13 ממלא הוא … או ק' לשתות וכ' he may (dip in and) fill a cup, bucket or ladle for drinking purposes, and intend to immerse them (for ritual purposes). Ib. XIV (XV), 3. Succ. II, 9 לעבד … ק' וכ' like the case of a servant that comes in to mix the cup for his master, and he pours the ladle in his face; ib. 29
<sup>a</sup> שפך לו רבו ק' וכ' his master poured &c. Snh. 52
<sup>b</sup> בתחלה דומה לק' וכ' at first acquaintance he (the scholar) appears to him (the ignorant man) like a golden 
<italic>kithon</italic>; if he holds conversation with him, he appears like a silver 
<italic>kithon</italic>; if he accepts a benefit of him, he appears like an earthen 
<italic>kithon</italic>, which once broken cannot be mended. Yoma IV, 5 מקדש … מן הק' וכ' he sanctifies his hands and feet with a golden ladle; a. fr.—Yalk. Sam. 124 נטל קטן השמן וכ' (corr. acc.) he took the pitcher of oil and poured &c.—
<plural-form>Pl. קִיתוֹנִים, קִיתוֹנוֹת</plural-form>. Sifré Num. 158. Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IV, 1 הלבס כדי לקבל ק' וכ' a defective caldron remains susceptible of levitical uncleanness so long as there is enough left to receive ladles, ladles, so long as they can contain small coins. Gen. R. s. 74 קִיתוֹנִיּוֹת; Yalk. ib. 130 קיתונות; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01227">
<head-word>קִיתוֹן</head-word>
<head-word>קִיתוֹנָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Esth. R. to II, 1 (introd.) the drunkard says, מה דהדין ק' דנחשא וכ' what this copper ladle serves for, an earthen ladle will do &c. Y. Kidd. III, 64
<sup>a</sup> הב לי ק' דאית וכ' give me the 
<italic>cyathus</italic> which I have with thee; הב לי קותונה וכ' (read: קִיתוֹנִי) give me my 
<italic>cyathus</italic>, and get the Denar (which I owe thee). Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42
<sup>d</sup> הוה ליה קווקין וכ' (corr. acc.) had a ladle on which was the figure of a Roman deity; אהן ק' מכיון וכ' a ladle, since it is dipped in water, is considered a common vessel (ornamentations of which have no idolatrous character); a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. קַיתוֹנַיָּא</plural-form>. Targ. Y. Num. XXXI, 23 (ed. Amst. קַתּוּנְיָא, corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01230">
<head-word>קַל</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<head-word>קַלָּה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) 
<italic>light</italic>; </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>unimportant, of minor value; easy to achieve</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—קל וחומר, v. חוֹמֶר I. Ḥull. XII, 5 מצוה ק' שהיא כאיסר a slight religious act which is performed at a sacrifice of one Isar. Y. Kidd. I, 61
<sup>b</sup> bot. השוה הכתוב מצוה ק' שבקַלּוֹת וכ' the Bible put the lightest of the light acts (Deut. XXII, 7) on the same level with the most serious (Ex. XX, 12). Tosef. Yoma V (IV), 4 מאכילין אותו הקל הקל you must give him to eat (of forbidden things on hand) that which is of comparatively minor import; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. קַלִּים, קַלִּין; קַלּוֹת</plural-form>.—קלים וחמורים, v. חוֹמֶר I.—Dem. I, 1 הק' שבדמאי those fruits with which, in cases of doubt as to tithes (v. דְּמַאי), the law deals most leniently. Yoma VIII, 8 על עבירות ק' for minor transgressions (to which the lowest penalty is attached); ib. 85
<sup>b</sup> אלו הן ק' וכ' these are the minor transgressions: omission of a positive command &c. (v. עָשָׂה); Tosef. ib. V (IV), 5. R. Hash. 25
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. שלשה קַלֵּי עולם the three worthless (chiefs) in Israel’s history, opp. חמורי עולם. Ib. אפי' קל שבק' וכ' (not קלין) even the most worthless of worthless men, if once appointed a leader, should be respected like the strongest &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>lowly, poor.</italic></definition>
<notes>—
<italic>Pl.</italic> as ab. Arakh. 24
<sup>a</sup> שלא ישהא מרגלית לק' one must not delay the valuation of a jewel dedicated for its value by poor men (for the sake of taking it to a large town where a higher price can be obtained, but it must go by its local value); ib. 18
<sup>a</sup> מרגלית לק' as to local valuation.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>quick</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. III, 12, v. נוֹחַ II. Ib. V, 20 הוי … קל כנשר וכ' be … swift as an eagle, and run like a deer to do the will of thy Father in heaven. Sabb. VIII, 5 ביצה ק' שבבצים the lightest of eggs; expl. ib. 80
<sup>b</sup> ק' לבשל quick to boil; Y. ib. VIII, 11
<sup>b</sup> top. Gen. R. s. 16, v. חַד I. Keth. 112
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Jer. III, 19 נחלת צבי) מה צבי זה קל … ק' לבשל וכ' as the deer is the swiftest of beasts, so the land of Israel is the swiftest of all lands to ripen its fruits. Ex. R. s. 19, a. fr. לשעה קלה after a short time; a. fr.—
<italic>Pl.</italic> as ab. Gen. R. l. c.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01231">
<head-word>קַל</head-word>
<hw-number>III</hw-number>
<head-word>קָל</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<head-word>קָלָא</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> c. = h. קוֹל, 
<italic>voice, sound; rumor</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ez. XI, 13. Targ. Gen. XXVII, 22. Targ. Ps. XCII, 12; a. fr.—M. Kat. 18

<italic>prostitution, house of prostitution; sodomy</italic>. Lam. <senses>

<notes /></sense>

<plural-form>pl. קְלוּטִים; קְלוּטיֹת</plural-form>. Sifra Emor, Par. 7, ch. VII (expl. קלוט, Lev. XXII, 23) פרסוֹת וכ' an animal whose hoofs resemble those of a horse &c.; Bekh. VI, 7 (40
<sup>a</sup>) שרגליו ק' וכ'. Ib. 6
<sup>a</sup> פרסותיה ק' its hoofs are closed, opp. סדוקות cloven. Ib. VII, 6 אצבעותיו … או ק' וכ' if his fingers lie one above the other or are grown together up to the root (פֶּרֶק). Y. Sot. IX, 23
<sup>d</sup>; a. e.—In gen. קָלוּט 
<italic>an animal with uncloven hoofs</italic> (having the sign of uncleanness) 
<italic>born of a clean animal, monster</italic> or 
<italic>hybrid</italic>. Bekh. 7
<sup>a</sup> ק' בן פרה a 
<italic>ḳaluṭ</italic> born of a cow; Ḥull. 68
<sup>b</sup>. Ib. ק' במעי פרה a 
<italic>ḳaluṭ</italic> found in a cow (after ritual slaughtering); ib. 69
<sup>a</sup>. Sabb. 67
<sup>a</sup> זרעיך כק' וכפרדה וכ' thy seed be like a 
<italic>ḳ</italic>. and like a mule &c. (Rashi: ‘like one whose semen is locked up’); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to clutch, intercept, receive; to conceive, retain, absorb</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 65
<sup>a</sup> כל עוף הקוֹלֵט מן האויר וכ' any bird that snatches in the air (for things thrown to it) is unclean. Gen. R. s. 41 אינה קוֹלֶטֶת, v. פֶּרֶד II. Ker. 5
<sup>a</sup> וק' את הריח and the oil retained (absorbed) the scent. Gen. R. s. 5 קְלָטָן הים the sea absorbed them (the waters of the rivers); Yalk. Ps. 848 קְלָטָם. Ab. V, 15 שמוציאה את היין וקולטת וכ' which passes the wine and retains the lees; שמוציאה … וק' את הסולת which passes the common flour and retains the fine flour (v. צוּף). Snh. 108
<sup>b</sup> כל שהתיבה קוֹלַטְתּוֹ whatever animal the ark received. Sabb. I, 6 כדי שיִקְלוֹט העין when there is time enough before the Sabbath for the wool to assume the color of the dye. Lev. R. s. 14 אין האשה קולטת וכ' a woman conceives only shortly after menstruation. Shebi. II, 6 כל הרכבה שאינה קולטת וכ' a grafting which does not take root within three days, will never do so; a. v. fr.—Ex. R. s. 1 ק' דרך וכ' he (Moses) adopted the manner of his ancestors (finding wives at the well); Tanḥ. Sh’moth 10 לקח.—Esp. (v. מִקְלָט) 
<italic>to protect, give the shelter of an asylum</italic>. Macc. 12
<sup>a</sup> אינו קולט אלא גגו only the top of the altar protects him that flees to it; אינו קולט … עולמים only the altar of the permanent sanctuary (in Jerusalem) offers protection; אינו קולט אלא כהן וכ' protects only the priest while at service &c. Ib. אינה קולטת אלא בצר only Bezer is an asylum (but not Bozrah). Ib.
<sup>b</sup> פלכו קוֹלְטוֹ his (the Levite’s) district protects him. Ib. עיר שקְלָטַתּוּ כבר a town which has received him once before. Sifré Num. 160 אין לי אלא שקוֹלְטוֹת בארץ this would indicate only that they (these cities) offer asylum for manslaughter committed in Palestine. Ib. לא קָלְטָה אחת מהם עד וכ' none of those cities had the right of asylum until all of them had been designated; a. fr.—Macc. 10
<sup>a</sup> מנין … קוֹלְטִין whence do you learn that the words of the Law offer protection (to its students)?; ib. קולטין ממלאך וכ' they protect from the angel of death.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (of sacred precincts) 
<italic>to retain; to make export illegal</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 19
<sup>b</sup> קְלָטוּהוּ מחיצות the sacred precincts have retained it (and it cannot be redeemed and taken out of Jerusalem again); ib. 20
<sup>a</sup>. Ib. מחיצה לִקְלוֹט דרבנן that the precincts have retaining power is merely a rabbinical enactment; Snh. 113
<sup>a</sup>; B. Mets. 53
<sup>b</sup>.—Part. pass. as ab. Sabb. 4

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>to swing</italic>] 
<italic>to be light, slender, unimportant</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. קַל. Snh. VI, 5 (ref. to קללת, Deut. XXI, 23) בזמן … קַלַּנִי מראשי וכ' when man suffers punishment, what does the Shekhinah say? ‘I am lighter than my head, than my arm’ (euphem. for, I feel my head heavy &c.); Y. ib. 23
<sup>d</sup> bot. אנן תנינן קַלֵּינִי (= קל איני) we read 
<italic>ḳalleni</italic>, I am not lighter; אית תניי תני קל אני some Tannai reads 
<italic>ḳ</italic>
<italic>al ăni</italic>; מאן דאמר קליני לית הוא אלא קליל according to him that reads 
<italic>ḳalleni</italic>, it is a euphemistic expression for ‘light’ (i.e. my head is light, I feel giddy; my arm is light, I feel weak); מאן דאמר קלני … נטיל according to the version 
<italic>ḳallani</italic>, it is a euphemistic expression for ‘heavy’ (i.e. my head, my arm is heavy); Bab. ib. 46
<sup>b</sup> Abbayi says כמאן דאמר קל לית (read 
<italic>ḳalleni</italic>) as one says, ‘light (I am) not’ (i.e. I feel heavy, without euphemism)—(which is refuted by Raba, who explains the word in question) קליל לי עלמא, v. קַלִּיל II.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֵיקַל, הֵקַל, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, הֵקיל I) 
<italic>to lighten</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. 17
<sup>b</sup> הכביד … מֵיקַל וכ' if the mourner’s hair is too heavy, he may make it lighter with a razor; Y. ib. III, 82
<sup>a</sup> top. Erub. IV, 9 להָקֵל על העשיר to make it easy for the rich man; a. fr.—Trnsf. ה' ראשו 
<italic>to be irreverent, talk frivolously</italic> (v. קַלּוּת). Ber. IX, 5 לא יָקֵל אדם את ראשו כנגד וכ' man (a pilgrim coming to Jerusalem) must not behave irreverently in sight of the eastern gate &c. Yalk. Gen. 24 מֵיקֶלֶת ראשה she is frivolous (light-minded); Yalk. Is. 265 מֵקֶילֶת ראש; (Gen. R. s. 18 מיקרת, v. יָקַר).—2) 
<italic>to be lenient; to incline towards the less restrictive practice</italic>, opp. החמיר, v. חָמַר I. Y. M. Kat. l. c. הלכה כדברי מי שהוא מיקל the adopted practice follows the opinion of him who is more lenient; Erub. 46
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. כדברי המיקל וכ'. Yeb. 88
<sup>a</sup> הֵיקַלְתָּ עליה, v. חָמַר I. Pes. 52
<sup>b</sup>, v. מַגִּיד. Erub. l. c. wherever you find יחיד מיקל ורבים וכ' an individual scholar favoring the more lenient practice against several in favor of restriction. Sabb. 129
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. ספק נפשות להָקל where there is a doubt involving the endangering of human life, the more lenient rule is applied; a. fr.—3) 
<italic>to be sparing, beggarly</italic>. Ib. כל המיקל … מְקִילִין לו מזוניתיו וכ' he that stints himself at the meal taken after blood-letting, to him they in heaven will give his sustenance stintingly; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<binyan-form>קִלֵּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>

<italic>to diminish</italic>,] 
<italic>to curse</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. VII, 6 מְקַלֶּלֶת, v. יִוֹלֵד. Sabb. 62
<sup>b</sup> שאשתו מְקַלַּלְתּוֹ בפניו whom his wife curses in his presence. Pes. 87
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Prov. XXX, 10 sq.) אפו' דור שאביו יְקַלֵּל וכ' even if it be a generation of men that curse their father …, do not denounce &c. Yoma 75
<sup>a</sup> ק' את הנחש וכ' God cursed the serpent, yet it climbs up the roof and finds its food. Sot. 11
<sup>a</sup> (expl. ועלה, Ex. I, 10, 
<pgbrk id="pg1378" />as euphem. for ועלינו) כאדם שמְקַלֵּל את עצמו וכ' like a man that wants to curse himself (express an ill omen about himself), and hangs his curse on others. B. Bath. 88
<sup>b</sup> הקב"ה בירך … וקִלְּלָן וכ' the Lord blessed Israel with the twenty-two letters of the alphabet (from א of אם, Lev. XXVI, 3, to ת of קוממיות, ib. 13), and cursed them with eight letters (from ו of ואם, ib. 14, to ם of נפשם, ib. 43). Snh. 70
<sup>a</sup> מתוך שקלקלו … קִלְּלוֹ ברביעי because Ham injured him by (preventing his begetting) a fourth son, he (Noah) cursed him by his fourth son (Canaan). Ib. 91
<sup>b</sup> כל המונע … שבמעי אמן מְקַלְּלִין אותו (not אמו) he that withholds a tradition from his pupil, even the embryos in their mother’s womb will curse him; Yalk. Prov. 947; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be cursed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 61
<sup>a</sup> בתחלה נ' … נִתְקַלְּלָה וכ' the serpent was cursed first, and then Eve &c.; Gen. R. s. 20; Erub. 18
